bestBets.overview: Track rated soft 6 at the time of acceptances with mostly sunny weather expected leading up to the weekend. CHICA ASTUTA was sent for a break following an easy debut win in February. Blinkers go on for the first time today and Noel Callow takes the ride. INHABIT led throughout to win on debut at Murray Bridge in October. She won a 1000m Murray Bridge trial in June but hasn't been seen since. PRETTY BABY has been freshened and is back in distance after winning the Oaklands Plate over 1400m. She'll carry 58kg after Caitlin Tootell's claim. Watch market moves for TULLY RAPIDS and DIRTY POKER.

raceTips.comment: Speed looks quite good via SIDEBAR and INHABIT. CHICA ASTUTA was impressive on debut when she finished strongly and looks a filly with some promise. She's been given a quite time in her trials and gets blinkers on here. INHABIT has ability but was hard to follow in her last few runs. Her best is good. PRETTY BABY has been freshened since a big win at stakes level.
